negative_reviews.author: Cynthia
negative_reviews.text:
Husband and I fell for the trap. Multiple locations across Glasgow, thousands of glowing Google reviews, sky-high ratings… so we thought “surely this can’t be mid.”
We were wrong.

I ordered the tonkatsu ramen. The broth was so salty it felt like it was actively trying to raise my blood pressure on the spot. The meat was tough, dry, and somehow both flavourless and offensive at the same time.

Husband went for the Hell Ramen, expecting actual heat. What he got was a mild, vaguely peppery soup that wouldn’t even make a toddler sweat. Zero kick. Just disappointment with a side of black pepper.

The portions were tiny. Laughably small amounts of actual food floating in oversized bowls that looked impressive until you realised half of it was empty space and the other half was salt water. Optical illusion ramen. The greatest magic trick Glasgow has ever pulled.

Service did the absolute bare minimum. No warmth, no effort, just the functional delivery of two underwhelming bowls and a quiet hope that we’d leave soon.

We left disappointed, still hungry, and slightly betrayed by every single 5-star review that lured us in. If this is what thousands of people are raving about, the bar for ramen in Glasgow is lying on the floor.

2 stars. One for the fact they managed to put noodles in a bowl, and one for the pure comedy of calling that broth “Hell.” Never again.

negative_reviews.author: Jack Darrer
negative_reviews.text:
The lunch offer is a lie...

"1 main + 1 side + 1 drink = £18 and if your food is not delivered in 30 mins you don't pay"

We only recieved our main and drink. Once we finished our mains we asked about our sides...

There had been a mix-up in the kitchen and we would have to wait 10 minutes for the sides to arrive but we were on our lunch break and did not have the time to wait.

So what did the manager do?

1. Offered a bill that simply took the cost of the sides off. We refused this as I wouldn't have paid £14.90 for a ramen on it's own

2. The manager offered a 20% discount - we accepted because I couldn't be bothered arguing.

Overall, very poor experience - don't have an offer if you won't stand by it

negative_reviews.author: Danial Rahman
negative_reviews.text:
The food at Maki & Ramen was great, although the overall experience could have been better.

I waited around 30 minutes for my food before being informed that there was an issue with their ordering system. I was quite hungry and was actually about to cancel my order when the food finally arrived.

Thankfully, the staff managed to resolve the issue on the spot and kindly offered complimentary drinks to make up for the delay, which I appreciated.

Despite the long wait, the food was delicious, and I appreciated how the staff handled the situation. Hopefully, the ordering system can be improved to avoid similar delays in the future. Would definitely give it another try!

negative_reviews.author: Karena
negative_reviews.text:
I have been a regular customer here and have always had great experiences, but unfortunately, today’s visit was disappointing.

We specifically asked whether the lunch menu was still available and made it clear that we wanted to order from it. However, I ordered Karaage but was served Teriyaki chicken instead. When I questioned it, the staff member confidently that it was what I had ordered.

To make matters worse, the bill came to over £57. I had to point out that we had ordered two lunch menus. Thankfully, another male staff member corrected the bill.

I believe the service quality needs improvement. Staff should have a better understanding of the menu and the restaurant’s products to provide a more professional and reliable service.

negative_reviews.author: Mavis
negative_reviews.text:
We ordered ramen, but it arrived so late that we had nearly finished our entire meal by the time it finally came. On top of that, the taste was honestly ridiculous. It tasted more like instant noodles with an excessive amount of seasoning powder added. It was unbelievably salty and barely enjoyable.
The salmon panko sushi was equally disappointing. All I could taste was green onion, to the point where I genuinely couldn't even tell there was salmon in it. The fried coating was so hard and over-fried that it actually made my mouth bleed.
